explanation: Predictions about future events, often given by God through a prophet.
An ancient empire that dominated large parts of the Middle East, including Iran and parts of present-day Iraq, Turkey, Afghanistan, and Pakistan.
The empire founded by Alexander the Great, which stretched from Greece to Egypt and India.
A ruler over a country or territory, often inheriting the position and holding absolute power.
A reference to the Seleucid Empire, one of the Hellenistic states after the death of Alexander the Great, controlling areas in Anatolia, Persia, Mesopotamia, and the Levant.
A reference to the Ptolemaic dynasty, which ruled Egypt and parts of the Middle East after the death of Alexander the Great.
The final period in human history before God's final judgment and the establishment of a new heavenly kingdom.
An evil and powerful person who will oppose God and His people in the end times.
A term for the descendants of the patriarch Jacob, also known as Israel. In this context, it refers to the Jews and their nation.
The Temple in Jerusalem, which was the center of Jewish religious practice and a symbol of God's presence among His people.
